transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I came in because I just can't seem to get anything in order anymore. It's... my kitchen table is just covered with things. My husband's appointment papers, church flyers, senior-center notes... half-finished lists. I just sit there. I don't know which thing to do first, and... then the whole day is just gone.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
No... not really. I don't feel sad or anything. I still like the things I always have.
Do you often feel worried, anxious, or on edge about things?
No... I don't think so. I wouldn't say I feel anxious or on edge. I just... well, I just can't seem to do what I need to do. But I don't really sit around worrying.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels lately, or do you often feel tired or fatigued even after resting?
No... I wouldn't say that. My energy is about the same as it always is. I'm not really tired... I just don't seem to do anything.
